notes: Multimeter tester round 2. Port picker now lists only USB serial devices — no more 30-row wall of legacy tty ports — with bigger, readable buttons (a lone USB port is picked automatically). New RATE presets in the meter window (1/s, 2/s, 4/s, 10/s — saved per install), and the meter now uses the fast SCPI dialect (:DMM:MEAS?) so high rates are actually fast; the old :READ? command blocked ~1s per reading. Fixed: a single click on the meter window header teleported it to the top-left corner (clicks now keep the position, drags are clamped to the screen — same fix for the Power Sequence panel). Linux: proper icon size set + window icon, so the minimized/taskbar icon is no longer a blank sliver. The meter now reconnects by itself when the USB link drops — unplug/replug and it comes back without pressing CONNECT; if it stays gone, check the meter's own AUTO-OFF setting.
